summary.text: Curtis Goodwin is the Libertarian nominee for Arizona's 2nd Congressional District. He says he was born and raised in Mesa, Arizona, and has traveled to 268 U.S. cities over the last 8 years.

paragraphs.text: Says he was born and raised in Mesa, Arizona, and that he has a daughter, a grandson, and a son.
Completed his high school studies as a homeschooled student and has worked as a technician, according to Ballotpedia.
Says he has traveled to 268 different cities across the United States in the last eight years.
